children: Catcher Predict reported a sharp move in the Polymarket submarket for the US Open WTA match between Aryna Sabalenka and Elena Rybakina. According to ChainCatcher, the probability of the "Over" option in the first-set total games market O/U 8.5 fell from 78.5% one hour earlier to 50%, a 28.5 percentage-point drop.

title: Polymarket Sabalenka-Rybakina First-Set Games Over Odds Swing Sharply
